title: Text API gains function calling
summary:
The text API added function calls and streaming responses, with some less glamorous web-search plumbing alongside them.

Clients can pass `tools` and `tool_choice` in completion requests, receive tool calls, and send function results back in follow-up messages. The OpenAI-compatible response format preserves those calls.

Requests with `stream: true` can receive provider-backed, OpenAI-style server-sent events instead of waiting for a completed response. Streaming errors use a format streaming clients can read.

Search requests can be distributed across two Bing API keys. Search tool handling was also separated by response mode: non-streaming search handles web search and scraping calls on the server, while streaming search passes the configured tools to the model.

highlights.title: Function calls in text
highlights.text: Pass `tools` and `tool_choice` in a completion request, then send tool results back in a follow-up message. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Streaming text responses
highlights.text: Set `stream: true` to receive OpenAI-style server-sent events as the provider generates a response. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
